name: code-relay
description: Host-led coding delegation to user-configured API models.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate repetitive code. Keep host review.
interface.longDescription: Use Codex for architecture, complex coding and review while bounded API workers prepare candidate changes. Supports multiple user-configured OpenAI-compatible, ELM and Anthropic model profiles with independent credentials.
defaultPrompt: Delegate routine coding to my configured API models.
Plan a safe batch of test and documentation tasks.
Review the candidate changes from my API workers.
